description_en: Changes the image for one or more cloud computers
description_zh: 为一台或多台云电脑变更镜像
kebab_example: aliyun ecd rebuild-desktops --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --desktop-id ecd-gx2x1dhsmucyy0000 --image-id m-84mztzatmlnys0000 --operate-type replace --biz-language en-US --after-status Running --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: RebuildDesktops

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call [DescribeRegions](~~DescribeRegions~~) to query the list of regions supported by Elastic Desktop Service
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~DescribeRegions~~)获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The cloud computer IDs. You can specify 1 to 20 IDs
parameters.name: desktop_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the new image to use after the change
parameters.help_zh: 变更后要使用的新镜像ID
parameters.name: image_id

parameters.help_en:
The operation type for the data cloud disk.

Regardless of whether the cloud computer has a data cloud disk, no field value is passed in by default when you call this operation.

If the cloud computer has no data cloud disk:  
        No data cloud disk operation is performed regardless of the field value passed in.
If the cloud computer has a data cloud disk:
    1. When the operating system of the cloud computer is the same as the target image operating system:
        - If the field value is `replace`, the data cloud disk of the cloud computer is replaced.
        - If no field value is passed in, the original data cloud disk of the cloud computer is retained.
    2. When the operating system of the cloud computer is different from the target image operating system:
        - If the field value is `replace`, the data cloud disk of the cloud computer is replaced.
        - If no field value is passed in, the data cloud disk of the cloud computer is cleared
parameters.help_zh:
操作数据盘类型。

不论云电脑是否有数据盘，调用此接口默认都是不传入任何字段值。

若云电脑无数据盘：  
        传入任何字段都不会进行数据盘操作。
若云电脑包含数据盘：
    1. 当云电脑操作系统和目标镜像操作系统相同时：
        -  传入字段为`replace`时，替换云电脑的数据盘。
        -  不传入任何字段时，保留云电脑原来的数据盘。
    2. 当云电脑操作系统和目标镜像操作系统不同时：
        - 传入字段为`replace`时，替换云电脑的数据盘。
        - 不传入任何字段时，清空云电脑数据盘
parameters.name: operate_type

parameters.help_en: The operating system language. Currently, only system images are supported, and Linux computers only support English
parameters.help_zh: 操作系统语言。目前只支持系统镜像，并且Linux电脑仅支持选择英文
parameters.name: language

parameters.help_en: The target status of the cloud computer after the rebuild is complete
parameters.help_zh: 重建完成后云电脑的目标状态
parameters.name: after_status
